summary: UML Sequence Diagrams specification document for Lion International Bank HRMS (LIBHRMS / anbesa_hr). Details the time-ordered interactive message flows for the two most critical banking operations: (1) Multi-Tier Maker-Checker Monthly Payroll Batch Execution & CBS Export, and (2) Dual-Calendar Leave Application with Reliever Handover and Immutable Ledger Debit.
